clips.title: The story
paras: Foggy MacKreel sleeps through his watch on the broken Thandol Span after drinking too much of his own moonshine. Now he needs an Alliance traveler to hurry a fresh batch to Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore and settle his debt.

Foggy MacKreel keeps watch on the shattered Thandol Span, where the hours are wet, cold, and dull. To bear the damp chill, he drinks his homemade moonshine, a brew so fierce he likens its aftereffects to siege engines pounding across his skull. One drink too many leaves him passed out through his shift. Longbraid the Grim commands the dwarves defending the Span, and Foggy cannot afford another lapse in discipline.

Foggy also owes Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore a longstanding debt. He promised a batch of his personal brew to settle the account, but his hangover and watch duties leave him minutes from missing the deadline. With gryphons and swift feet, you race across the Arathi Highlands to Southshore with the jug, before Bilger decides Foggy has skipped out on his tab again.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Had quite a bit of the ol' Moonshine last night! Longbraid would have my head if he knew that I passed out during my watch.
The noggin hurts something fierce. Felt as though a whole brigade of siege engines passed overhead, all that rumbling.
Oh my, look at the time! I promised Brewmeister Bilger in Southshore that I'd repay my debt to him by sending some Moonshine.
But there are just 15 minutes left before I'm overdue! Take him this batch, would you please? And hurry!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, nothing like Foggy MacKreel's Moonshine to warm you up on a brisk day! And here I was thinking the little bugger was going to be overdue on his bills again. Thank you, friend! Many thanks indeed!
